v0.1.0.description:
## How to use

For Archipelago instructions, see https://archipelago.gg/tutorial/

1) Generate a new Archipelago multiworld.
2) Launch the Heroes of the Storm Client from the ArchipelagoLauncher.exe.
3) Connect to your server.
4) Once connected, you can launch Heroes of the Storm normally and begin playing.
5) Checks will be sent once a match is complete.
